messages:
Ava (partnerships): Quick flag 1: partner-X staging metering totals are ~2% lower than their declared staging exports. Thinking pause final cutover until we validate.
Sam (billing): I can confirm the gap on our hourly rollups. Looks concentrated on DST boundary days and some late-heartbeat batches.
Diego (eng): Triage: partner sends minute-level webhooks but timestamps use local offsets. Our normalizer converts to UTC and then hour-buckets by event_ts. When partner batches and uses local clock, events sometimes land in the previous hour after conversion and fail our idempotency logic (we key by device_id+hour_bucket).
Maya (product): Do we have sample payloads to show partner?
Diego (eng): Example (redacted):
```
{ "device_id":"edge-4421", "usage":12, "timestamp":"2026-03-15T00:32:10-07:00", "entitlement_id":"ent-xyz-123", "nonce":"abcd-1234" }
```
Diego (eng): Proposed short-term mitigations: 1) finer idempotency key: device_id + minute-truncated event_ts_utc for 48h; 2) bucket by max(event_ts, ingest_ts) to reduce mis-bucket on delayed arrivals; 3) add alert if hourly delta > 0.5%.
Sam (billing): Need reconciliation SQL and a before/after dashboard. If we mirror staging feed we can run a 7-day dry-run and produce a partner report.
Maya (product): Timeline suggestion: today EOD patch -> +24h mirrored dry-run -> +4836h evaluate delta <0.5% to allow go-live.
Ava (partnerships): I'll own partner comms. Lina (SI) please validate telemetry mapping on your side before flip.
Lina (SI): Acknowledge, will run mapping check once you share the sample payloads and the staging report.
meter-bot: ingest: received 28 events for entitlement ent-xyz-123 from edge-4421 at 2026-03-15T07:33:01Z
Sam (billing): I'll create GH issue and temporary dashboard. Diego, can you drop the PR link here when ready?
Diego (eng): Will open PR with tests and canary plan by 3160004500. Adding monitoring to auto-fallback to dedicated metering pipeline if delta persists 3hrs.
Ava (partnerships): Partner message draft: "Pausing final production flip for a short validation window. We'll share a reconciliation report within 24h and coordinate next steps."
Sam (billing): Owners: Diego (patch + SQL), Sam (dashboard + GH issue), Ava (partner comms), Maya (product sign-off), Lina (SI validation). Let's reconvene in-thread with PR + report links. :thumbsup:
